card.name: Words inside fixed, repeated phrases
card.fires_on: Words in the middle of stock phrases that are copied from memory, such as 'his first imprisonment at Rome', 'known or suspected pregnancy' and 'latent tuberculosis or tuberculin reactivity'. The pole fires on the word that comes right before the phrase finishes.
